meta_title: About VpnHood!: an Open-Source VPN Built for Censored Networks
meta_description: Why VpnHood! exists, what makes it different and who makes it: a VPN built from scratch for networks that block VPNs, open source and independently audited.
page_desc: We make a VPN that keeps working where networks block VPNs, and we make it in the open: the code is public, it has been independently audited, and anyone can run it on a server of their own.
hero_alt: A globe drawn in purple lines
why_title: Internet access should not depend on where you live
why_desc: In many countries, networks block websites and apps, and the VPNs people use to reach them, and they keep getting better at spotting VPN traffic. VpnHood! is made for those networks. Our goal is that anyone, wherever they live, can reach the open internet and use it privately.
diff_title: Built for the networks that block VPNs
diff_desc: Most VPNs are easy to spot, and a network that wants to block them simply does. VpnHood! is built to get through, and built so that anyone can check how.
scratch_desc: The VpnHood! ENGINE is our own, written in .NET by the VpnHood team. It does not wrap or reuse any other VPN software, and it speaks a protocol of its own.
hidden_title: Hard to spot, hard to block
hidden_desc: Its traffic is shaped to look like ordinary encrypted browsing, so there is no VPN signature for a firewall to match. In Cloak Mode, the server looks like a web server.
open_desc: VpnHood! CONNECT, VpnHood! CLIENT, the server and the VpnHood! ENGINE behind them are published on GitHub under the LGPL, and Include Security has audited them for the Open Technology Fund's Red Team Lab.
self_desc: Rather not trust anyone, us included? VpnHood! SERVER is free and open source: run it on a machine of your own, and your VPN answers to nobody's infrastructure but yours.
make_title: Use it, run it, sell it or build on it
make_desc: Our own VPN service, the software to run your own, a program to sell ours, and the parts to build your own app.
connect_desc: Our VPN app, on our own servers around the world: free with ads, or Premium without them.
client_desc: The free, open-source app for your own VPN server: paste an access key and connect, on Android, iOS, Apple TV, Windows or Linux.
server_desc: The free, open-source VPN server for Linux, Windows and Docker. It runs on your own machine and carries your users' traffic.
manager_desc: The web panel that installs your servers, balances users across them and issues their access keys.
reseller_desc: Resell VpnHood! with premium codes, a store of your own or your own brand, and never run a server.
developer_desc: VpnHood! is built from components. Use any of them in your own product, or build your own VPN app from our open-source template.
company_desc: VpnHood! is made by OmegaHood LLC. We publish our code, our audit and our changes in the open, so you can check our work rather than take our word for it.
fact_audit_value: Include Security, for the Open Technology Fund's Red Team Lab
end_desc: Get VpnHood! CONNECT, or tell us what you have in mind.
